summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release that provides a routine quarterly update on its capital markets activities, including an at-the-market equity program and equity participation by employees and directors. The press release discloses that under the ESP, employees purchased 26,256 common shares with a matching company acquisition; the company granted 91,954 DSUs to non-employee directors; and during the quarter the company generated ~US$2.1M in gross proceeds from the ATM program. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC transaction is described. This is a routine business update, not a special situation event.
